metadataRaw.title: Release THIS Muscle to Fix Your Neck Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to release the levator scapulae—one of the most common and overlooked muscles responsible for neck pain.

When this muscle becomes tight and weak over time, it can lead to stiffness, limited movement, and persistent discomfort. In this video, you’ll learn simple exercises to release, stretch, and strengthen the levator scapulae (along with key supporting muscles) to help reduce pain and improve neck mobility.

Each exercise targets the muscle in a different way, so for best results, try them all and keep the ones that give you the most relief—for both fast and long-term neck pain relief.
